items.description: Loading placeholder: a live region (role=status, aria-busy) with a faint 0.3rem grid scan that runs three passes and then stays still. Under reduced or off motion the scan never starts.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The grid scan is a CSS gradient and a Web Animation; no original assets are used.
